metadata.title: Davi Peterson | Junior Full Stack Developer
metadata.description: Portfolio of Davi Peterson, a junior full stack developer in Manaus who works with Next.js and NestJS and founded SyncForge.

hero.title: Hi, I'm
hero.subtitle: I build well-made, easy-to-use web systems with Next.js and NestJS.
hero.mailBody: Hi Davi! I saw your portfolio and would like to talk.

paragraphs.first: Full Stack Developer with experience in infrastructure and integrations. I work on interfaces, APIs, caching, queues, asynchronous processing and AI solutions, following each system from conception through release and maintenance in production.
paragraphs.second: I have led development teams technically, assigning tasks, reviewing Pull Requests and guiding developers, while taking part in architecture decisions and delivery planning. I work with a focus on maintainability and on technical decisions aligned with the product's needs.

performance.title: Performance
performance.description: End-to-end optimization, covering caching, SSR, and asynchronous processing for maximum fluidity.

architecture.title: Architecture & Design
architecture.description: Designing scalable solutions using microservices, ensuring high availability and easy maintenance.

scalability.title: In production
scalability.description: Multi-tenant SaaS products already running in production, built and maintained by me.

solasstec.title: Junior Software Developer
solasstec.description: I maintain and evolve systems used by public agencies, with Next.js on the front end and NestJS on the back end.
achievements: I build and maintain features for these systems.
I refactor code to make it more readable, organized, fast and easy to maintain.

dgComputer.title: Hardware Technician
dgComputer.description: I provided technical support and assembled and maintained computers, networks and systems.
achievements: I handled IT service and support, with preventive and corrective equipment maintenance.
I assembled and configured desktops, laptops and network devices such as switches and routers.
I installed operating systems, drivers and software, tuning and troubleshooting them.

nxsSkill.title: Volunteer Software Developer
nxsSkill.description: I built the front end of an educational platform, with attention to accessibility and performance, and collaborated on the design system and authentication flows.
achievements: I built version 2.0 of the web platform with a team of 6 developers.
I built responsive authentication, sign-up and dashboard interfaces with Next.js and TypeScript.
I implemented back-end modules and API routes for the new features.

syncForge.title: Founder and CEO
syncForge.description: I founded SyncForge and run the company end to end: from project planning to system architecture and development, leading a multidisciplinary team.
achievements: I lead the team of developers, QAs, analysts and marketing, setting priorities and assigning the tasks for each delivery.
I define the architecture and technical organization of the systems, with the standards the team follows.
I plan projects and track deliveries, from the initial scope to release.
I develop alongside the team and give technical support, guiding developers day to day.

twoBrains.title: Junior Software Developer
twoBrains.description: I built internal and client products with Next.js, React and Node.js, and was the architect of ContaCloud.
achievements: I split ContaCloud's operations into microservices and integrated LangGraph and LangChain automations to issue invoices through the Focus API.
I used AWS serverless, storage and API services, with support from the team.
I fixed bugs and evolved features on the front end and back end.

indicai.title: Software Developer (Contractor)
indicai.description: I worked as a contractor (MEI) on full stack development and DevOps: I built features, fixed bugs, integrated APIs and took part in deploying the app.
achievements: I defined the project's architecture and code standards.
I built interfaces faithful to the design, with attention to UX/UI, accessibility and performance.
I planned and ran the deploy cycle, including the app's launch on the Play Store and the App Store.

uape.title: Software Developer Intern
uape.description: Full stack internship focused on architecture, service integration and good code practices, with participation in AI and Data Science initiatives for internal products.
achievements: I built a payment management system from start to finish, deployed in 3 states.
I created landing pages in Portuguese, English and Spanish, with internationalization (i18n).
I set up environments and infrastructure on Windows and Linux (Ubuntu) and provided technical support.

residuum.title: Volunteer Mentor and Developer
residuum.description: Invited by UniNorte, I provide technical guidance for the Residuum project, built by eighth-semester Computer Science and Computer Engineering students during their mandatory internship. I assign and explain tasks, track deliveries and review Pull Requests.
achievements: I led a complete refactor of the application in 2 weeks, with a visual redesign and a new landing page, to meet a tight deadline.
I optimized the queries behind the map search for collection points and each user's products, reducing response time.
I work on the FastAPI back end, refactoring the data model and complex business rules, and on the React front end, with fixes and UX/UI improvements.

nexusSkills.title: Nexus Skills
nexusSkills.description: Course platform for developing soft skills.

uape.title: UAPE
uape.description: Corporate landing page for UAPÉ, presenting its data engineering for global health: data sovereignty, fast deployment, offline mobile data collection, integration between health systems and real-time visualizations, in Portuguese, English and Spanish.

masterMind.title: Master Mind
masterMind.description: Financial management SaaS built as a modular monolith, with an integrated payment gateway and features that can be used through Telegram.

contaCloud.title: ContaCloud
contaCloud.description: Accounting SaaS that issues invoices from text or voice messages on WhatsApp, with LangGraph and LangChain automations on top of the Focus API. Organized in microservices, it uses Next.js SSR and caching.

maucco.title: Maucco
maucco.description: Freelance landing page for Maucco, an environmental consultancy in Manaus. It presents their environmental licensing and compliance services and guides visitors to book a free consultation.

operis.title: Operis
operis.description: Multi-tenant SaaS for point of sale and cash flow, under continuous development. It records sales, updates stock instantly and tracks installments and accounts payable and receivable, in the browser on a computer or phone.

forgePath.title: ForgePath CLI
forgePath.description: Terminal tool in Go that scans your folders, identifies each project's framework and quickly opens the one you choose.

syncForge.title: SyncForge
syncForge.description: Corporate landing page for SyncForge, a software house in Manaus. It presents its custom systems and websites, how the company works and SIGEM, its management system, with direct contact through WhatsApp.

residuum.title: Residuum
residuum.description: Reverse logistics and circular economy platform that connects people who want to dispose of waste with those who collect it, with a map search for collection points.
